recognize_zh: 腸黏膜的固有層被密集、單一形態的中型細胞瀰漫取代，細胞核圓至卵圓、胞質淡嗜酸至透明、界限清楚，把腺體與絨毛狀突起撐開，表面上皮完整；需以 CD117/tryptase 證實為肥大細胞腸道浸潤。
features: Diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate expanding the lamina propria and deeper mucosa
Monotonous medium-sized cells with round to oval nuclei and moderate pale eosinophilic to clear cytoplasm
Distinct cell borders give a cohesive, somewhat epithelioid appearance
Overlying intestinal epithelium with goblet cells is intact; residual glands are widely separated
Scattered thin fibrous bands and capillaries; no lymphoepithelial lesions or necrosis evident
describe_en: Section of intestinal mucosa shows an intact surface epithelium with goblet cells overlying a lamina propria that is diffusely expanded by a dense, monotonous infiltrate. The cells are medium-sized with round to oval nuclei, moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and distinct cell borders, arranged in cohesive sheets that separate the residual glands. No lymphoepithelial lesions or necrosis are identified. In the context of known mast cell leukemia, the findings are consistent with gastrointestinal involvement by neoplastic mast cells, which should be confirmed with CD117, tryptase and CD25 immunostains.

ddx.vs: MALT lymphoma consists of small centrocyte-like B cells with lymphoepithelial lesions and CD20 positivity, lacking tryptase/CD117 expression.
Mantle cells are small with scant cytoplasm and irregular nuclei and express CD20, CD5 and cyclin D1.
Carcinoma shows greater nuclear pleomorphism, gland formation or infiltration of epithelium, and cytokeratin positivity.
Myeloid sarcoma has blastic chromatin with nucleoli and expresses MPO, lysozyme or CD34 rather than tryptase.
